PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES ACT 1988

PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES

(MEASURES WITHIN INFECTED LOCAL AREAS) (RECOVERY MOVEMENT CONTROL)

(NO. 3) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 13) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 11(2) of

the Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [Act 342],

the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Prevention and Control of

Infectious Diseases (Measures within Infected Local Areas) (Recovery Movement

Control) (No. 3) (Amendment) (No. 13) Regulations 2021.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 29 April 2021.

Substitution of regulation 3

2. The Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases (Measures within

Infected Local Areas) (Recovery Movement Control) (No. 3) Regulations 2021

[P.U. (A) 98/2021], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these

Regulations, are amended by subtituting for regulation 3 the following regulation:

"Interpretation

3. In these Regulations, "infected local area" means any area declared

to be an infected local area under the Prevention and Control of Infectious

Diseases (Declaration of Infected Local Areas) Order 2020 [P.U. (A) 87/2020].".

Substitution of regulation 7A

3. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 7A the

following regulation:

"Movement for purpose of touring

7A. A person may move for the purpose of touring activity to any place within

the infected local areas specified in column (1) of the First Schedule subject to any

conditions determined by the Director General from time to time as published in

the official website of the National Security Council.".

Deletion of regulation 8

4. The principal Regulations are amended by deleting regulation 8.

Amendment of regulation 9

5. Regulation 9 of the principal Regulations is amended by deleting the words

"from one zone to another zone within the State of Sabah, or".

Substitution of First Schedule

6. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for the First Schedule

the following schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

APPLICATION

[Regulation 2]

(1)

Infected Local Area/Division/District

(2)

Period

1. State of Kedah except Kuala Muda District 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

2. State of Malacca 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

3. State of Negeri Sembilan except Seremban District 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

4. State of Pahang 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

5. State of Perak 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

6. State of Perlis 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

7. State of Terengganu 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

8. Federal Territory of Putrajaya 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021

9. Federal Territory of Labuan 29.4.2021 – 17.5.2021".

Deletion of Second Schedule

7. The principal Regulations are amended by deleting the Second Schedule.

Made 28 April 2021

[KKM.600-29/4/146 Jld.2 (30); PN(PU2)470/Jld. 6]

DATO' SRI DR. ADHAM BIN BABA

Minister of Health
